mapper.select: select Month(od.created_at) as MONTH, count(od.id) as totalOrderCnt, SUM(od.total_payment_price) as totalPaymentPrice, count(oc.id) as totalCouponUseCnt, SUM(od.total_discount_price) as total_discount_price from order_detail od left join order_coupon oc on od.id = oc.order_id where od.created_at BETWEEN #{startedAt} and #{endedAt} group by MONTH order by MONTH;
